{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of unique patient_id values and total rows
n_rows = len(df)
n_unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()

duplicates = n_rows - n_unique_patients
print(f'Rows: {n_rows}, Unique patients: {n_unique_patients}, Duplicate rows: {duplicates}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
n_neg999 = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {n_neg999}')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient to see if higher seq supersedes
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Patient with highest sample_seq per patient:
{sample_seq_max.head()}')"}
